distinct_from.GENERAL_IT: GENERAL_IT trains a support specialist running a public desk (accounts, disks, DNS, change windows). DIGITAL_CONFIDENCE is for adults returning to computers: paths, storage units, passphrases, reading links, spreadsheet formulas, typing, attachments, backups, contrast, and a personal safety plan.

claim_boundary: Practice files and made-up accounts only; no patron data. Not a digital-literacy certificate. Not student/teacher E6.
